transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.body: {{name}} becomes the owner of this trip and you become an editor. Only the owner manages members and invitations.

remove.title: Remove member
remove.body: {{name}} loses access to this trip on every device. They can be invited again.

leave.title: Leave the trip
leave.body: You lose access to this trip on this device and every other. You need a new invitation to come back.

invite.title: Invite
invite.emailBody: They get a mail with a link that works once, for 7 days, and joins them as an editor.
invite.linkBody: Anyone with the link can join as an editor. It works once, for 7 days.
invite.linkShown: It is shown only now: copy it before leaving.
invite.offline: You need a connection to invite someone.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.revokeBody: The link stops working at once. Anyone who already has it cannot join.

travellers.title: Travellers
travellers.body: Everyone on the trip, with or without the app: for seats and, later, who paid what.
travellers.name: Name
travellers.removeBody: {{name}} disappears from the seats and expense splits of this trip.

errors.E_OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE: Transfer ownership to someone else first.
errors.E_TRIP_ROLE: Only the trip owner can do this.
errors.E_NOT_A_MEMBER: That person is no longer a member.
errors.E_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.E_UNAUTHORIZED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.E_BAD_CSRF_TOKEN: This page is out of date. Reload and try again.
errors.network: No connection. Showing what this device has.
